context: Mei and Aoi, casual chat about a forgetful day.
purpose: Everyday casual register hitting conjugated stems (しまい/なけれ/ほか) naturally.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今日、財布を家に置いてきてしまい。
lines.en: Today I left my wallet at home.
lines.style: soft rueful woman voice, gentle warm sheepish delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: えっ、わたしが立て替えようか?
lines.en: Oh, shall I cover it for you?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm helpful cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ありがとう。あとで返さなければね。
lines.en: Thanks. I have to pay you back later.
lines.style: grateful woman voice, gentle warm sincere delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あまり気にしないで。ほかに何か要る?
lines.en: Don't worry about it. Need anything else?
lines.style: warm barista voice, soft warm caring cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ううん、もう失敗しないようにしなければ。
lines.en: No, I just have to stop making mistakes.
lines.style: soft determined woman voice, gentle warm rueful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: わたしも、よく鍵を忘れてしまうよ。
lines.en: I often forget my keys too.
lines.style: reassuring barista voice, soft warm relatable cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ほかの人も同じなら、安心するな。
lines.en: If others are the same, I feel relieved.
lines.style: lighter woman voice, gentle warm comforted delivery throughout
